record.reason: The method distills discrete diffusion samplers by matching conditional distributions to one- or few-step students, targeting fewer function evaluations. It is a plausible text-generation acceleration method if applied to language diffusion, but the paper’s scope/evaluation does not establish an LLM-serving improvement.
record.title: Distillation of Discrete Diffusion by Exact Conditional Distribution Matching
